title: Watch what they do with a retired robot
caption:
Figure AI trained its F.02 robots to jump autonomously, shipped them to Finland, and had them leap into a vat of molten steel.

Figure CEO Brett Adcock posted the behind-the-scenes footage on X.
The company says it trained the robots to jump on their own before the decommission.
